antd Progress type="circle" wrapped as ProgressStyled ; stroke colour is getClassificationColor(profile_completion.classification) .
TBC — two things . (1) The stroke colour is keyed to classification , and I do not have the classification→colour map, so the ring is drawn with --success . (2) This is a conic-gradient, antd draws an SVG arc: the cap shape and the track colour will differ. Measure both on live.
